insight.legacy-flesh-regenerator.outcome: At the start of your turn while below half Hit Points and above zero, spend 1 Stamina to regain 5 Hit Points; uses equal your Proficiency Bonus between Full Cultivation Sessions

insight.legacy-heavenly-circulation.outcome: Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, begin your turn below half Qi and regain CL + key ability modifier Qi without an action

insight.legacy-hidden-reserves.outcome: Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, when damage reduces you to half Hit Points or fewer, choose an active Path pool and regain twice your Proficiency Bonus cultivation points

insight.legacy-immortals-sinews.outcome: Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws; double carrying capacity

insight.legacy-mountain-crushing-fist.outcome: Once per turn on an unarmed hit, spend 2 Stamina for 2d8 extra Bludgeoning damage and a Strength save or push up to 10 feet

insight.legacy-will-manifestation.outcome: Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, choose to succeed after a failed saving throw

insight.legacy-heavens-luck.outcome: Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, reroll your attack roll or saving throw and use the new result

insight.legacy-unbroken-frame.outcome: Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, turn a failed Constitution saving throw into success, stand from Prone and end one effect causing Grappled or Restrained
